normal.decoded_age_definition: Time since the decoded frame currently committed by a successful Present; not end-to-end camera latency.

audit.scope: Recorded real encoded data + actual decoders + GPU uploads/presents. No camera end-to-end latency measurement.

full_recording.age_definition: Time since the decoded frame currently committed by a successful Present; not end-to-end camera latency.
full_recording.present_definition: Only RenderFrame=true; accepted uploads and UI iterations are counted separately.
